description: Read the current or terminal state of one Runtime-supervised background command owned by this agent. An optional bounded wait avoids shell-level sleep loops.

propertyDescriptions.commandId: The exact opaque command handle returned by start_command.
propertyDescriptions.waitMs: Omit for Runtime-managed waiting until completion or the configured wait limit (default 120000 ms), interruptible by user input. Explicit values 0..30000 ms request a shorter wait; 0 is an intentional immediate probe. The command timeout continues independently.

guidance: Use the original commandId and omit waitMs for Runtime-managed waiting. Do not issue rapid zero-wait polls or shell sleep loops. A running snapshot is not terminal success; inspect the terminal result before claiming validation.
